mapper.select: SELECT ID, KINDERGARTEN_ID, USER_ID, INVITER_ID, TYPE, ROLE_ID, DIRECTION, STATUS, UNIX_TIMESTAMP(CREATED_AT) * 1000 CREATED_AT, UNIX_TIMESTAMP(UPDATED_AT) * 1000 UPDATED_AT FROM T_INVITE WHERE KINDERGARTEN_ID = #{kindergartenId} AND STATUS = 'PENDING'

SELECT I.ID, I.KINDERGARTEN_ID, K.NAME KINDERGARTEN_NAME, I.USER_ID, I.INVITER_ID, I.TYPE, I.ROLE_ID, I.DIRECTION, I.STATUS, UNIX_TIMESTAMP(I.CREATED_AT) * 1000 CREATED_AT, UNIX_TIMESTAMP(I.UPDATED_AT) * 1000 UPDATED_AT FROM T_INVITE I JOIN T_KINDERGARTEN K ON K.ID = I.KINDERGARTEN_ID WHERE I.USER_ID = #{userId} AND I.STATUS = 'PENDING'
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO T_INVITE(KINDERGARTEN_ID, USER_ID, INVITER_ID, TYPE, ROLE_ID, DIRECTION, STATUS) VALUES (#{kindergartenId}, #{userId}, #{inviterId}, #{type}, #{roleId}, #{direction}, 'PENDING')
